content.title: Duke Freshman Cameron Boozer Highlights vs. UCF
content.text: Heralded Duke freshman Cameron Boozer did not disappoint in his debut for the Blue Devils. The son of former Duke legend Carlos Boozer played alongside his twin brother, Cayden against Johnny Dawkins' UCF Knights in the Brotherhood Run in Cameron Indoor Stadium. Duke won the game 96-71 with Cameron Boozer leading the way with 33 points on 12-19 shooting including 4-7 from three-point land to go along with a game-high 12 rebounds. Check out highlights from Boozer's incredible debut brought to you by the ACC Digital Network.
